content.text:
Process: Shell  (namespace: misc)
Description: Run a shell command

Arguments:
  Required:
    --in.infile <str>  The input file
  Optional:
    --envs.cmd <str> (default: '')  The shell command to run Use `$infile` and `$outfile` to refer to input and output files
    --envs.outdir <bool> (default: False)  Whether the `out.outfile` should be a directory.
If so a directory will be created before running the command.
    --outdir <str>  Output directory of the pipeline
    --forks <int>  Number of jobs to run simultaneously
    --scheduler <str>  Scheduler to run the jobs
    --profile <str>  Configuration profile to use
    --cache <str>  Cache strategy: true/false/force

Example:
  run_process("misc", "Shell", ["--in.infile", "<value>"])
